hero_heading: Google Ads Campaigns Built to Reach the Right Customers.
hero_text: I plan, launch and manage targeted Google Ads campaigns designed to help businesses reach potential customers, generate leads, and drive traffic and conversions.

sections.label: Why It Matters
sections.heading: Why Google Ads Is Important for Your Business
sections.subheading: Because Intent Starts With a Search.
sections.text: When people search on Google, they are often ready to find a solution. Google Ads puts your business in front of them at that moment, with a message built around what they are looking for.

sections.label: What I Offer
sections.heading: Google Ads Services
sections.text: From campaign setup to ongoing optimization, I provide practical Google Ads support to help your business reach the right audience.

sections.label: Why Work With Me
sections.heading: Why Google Ads With Me
sections.text: Running Google Ads is not just about launching campaigns and choosing keywords. Without a plan, budget can be spent without moving your business forward.

sections.heading: Ready to Reach More of the Right Customers?
sections.text: Let’s discuss your goals and explore how a targeted Google Ads strategy can support your business.

faqs.question: What Google Ads services do you offer?
faqs.answer: I offer search, display, shopping and video campaigns, remarketing, lead generation campaigns, conversion tracking setup, and ongoing optimization and reporting.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee leads or sales?
faqs.answer: No one can honestly guarantee specific leads or sales. I focus on careful targeting, clear tracking, transparent reporting, and continuous campaign improvement.

faqs.question: Do you set up conversion tracking?
faqs.answer: Yes. I set up tracking with Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics so you can understand how your campaigns are performing.

faqs.question: Do you work with businesses from different industries?
faqs.answer: Yes, I’m open to working with businesses across different industries, including healthcare, manufacturing, and food.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: You can get in touch through my contact form, email, or WhatsApp. We can discuss your requirements and explore the right approach for your business.
